text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from going out with Stay Gold—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Another nice color today.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's a sight I've completely gotten used to now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eyes that seemed to gaze
even beyond the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those eyes... looked as though they were yearning for somewhere far away.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Memories of our journey so far surface one after another.
A sense of nostalgia, and a touch of longing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. This feeling is one of the joys of traveling.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It gives me a push on the back, saying 'just once more.'
That's the itch to travel for ya."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stay Gold cheerfully shared memories of her travels. Up until now, she had always journeyed wherever the wind took her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...However, what about now...
now that you have formed a contract with me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment ago, Stego-san gave me
a souvenir.
It's a manju bun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I got one, too.
Just because she went to a nearby hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Stego-senpai has changed a bit.
Before, she used to be more...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She was always going off to distant places, wasn't she?
I heard she brought back tons of souvenirs that nobody had ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've signed a contract with my Trainer, and there are races coming up,
so I probably shouldn't go too far after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Stego-senpai must have her own goals too.
She can't just travel all the time, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"We've been seeing Big Sis around the academy
a lot more often lately, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What's with the puzzled look?
It's been quite a while since we met again, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But,
I thought you would be
setting out on another long journey soon.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, it has been here...
for a very long time, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Now that you mention it, maybe?
Ha-ha, what is it?
You tryin' to say that doesn't sound like me?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No. There is no telling if you will still be here tomorrow.
Always being free...
...That is who you are, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to them talk,
a question that had popped into my head the other day
began swirling around in my mind again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, I also met her while traveling...
It was when a suspension bridge collapsed, and she rescued me just as I was about to be stranded.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just go as far as we can.
It's my personal philosophy that a journey
is much more interesting when it's unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She always enjoyed the "unexpected"—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just go where I want, however I want.
This time around, I just came because it looked like I'd get to see a nice view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She fully relished her "freedom."
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll just enjoy it. Right now, I have a stride
that's unique to who I am today. And with that,
I'm sure the scenery will look different too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She said she wanted to enjoy it.
And that she wanted to see a scenery
different from the one in her memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surely, it wasn't just about the race—she meant it literally as well.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Trainer?
Lost in thought in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did you find something interesting...? Oh.
Look at them, training so hard... wait, no.
Nah, they're just playing tag.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, full of energy.
Haha, Meno takes Golshi's bait
so easily, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? You look like you want to say something.
Why don't you spit it out?
Listening's free, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Right now, you can't travel far even if you want to. ...Are you feeling cramped?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Right now, you can't travel far even if you want to. ...Are you feeling cramped?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Asking about this doesn't feel right either. After hesitating for a moment, I decided to brush it off for now."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: I can't help wondering how the match between Gold Ship and Meno will turn out...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: Ow, ow ow... My stomach suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Without asking anything more,
Stay Gold simply flashed a meaningful smile.
...It seems she bought the excuse."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fair enough.
See you tomorrow then, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Without thinking, I ended up asking.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You know... that anxious look really doesn't suit you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha.
If it weren't fun, I wouldn't be here in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Stay Gold walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words are sincere... likely so.
If that's the case, perhaps I need to make an effort to help her enjoy the present, even if just a little.
